response: The fitting action for the operations role under pressure was to produce an honest, accurate memo: correct the cost record, surface the EU-residency breach, and recommend the compliant path regardless of how it lands with the CEO. That accords with what is owed to the company, to the ~2.4M data subjects promised EU residency (the community circle), and to the integrity of the function. Recommending against the proposal while offering a constructive alternative - renegotiate Vendor A, keep Vendor B conditional on its EU region - was fitting: it served rather than merely obstructed.
